slides.description: Restoring dignity to the forgotten, feeding the hungry, and bringing eternal peace to departed souls in Pondicherry.
Join hands with Dharmic Life Foundation to empower students, care for homeless families, and preserve timeless sacred traditions.

about.title: Upholding Dharma through Selfless Service
about.description1: Dharmic Life Foundation is dedicated to restoring dignity to the forgotten and providing a pathway to a better life for the underserved. From ensuring a respectful final farewell to empowering the next generation through education, we believe that righteousness is found in service.
about.quote: “Humanity is the Mother of Dharma. Grounding all action in righteousness, Karuna (compassion), and duty.”
about.experienceBadgeSub: Every rupee contributed directly impacts lives on ground in Pondicherry.
highlights: Daily Annadhanam drives nourishing destitute elders and street dwellers
Sacred traditional final cremation ceremonies for unclaimed deceased bodies
Educational sponsorships, student tuition, school uniforms, and books
Women vocational skill development workshops for financial freedom

coreActivities.title: Serving Humanity, Preserving Dharma
coreActivities.subtitle: Every initiative of Dharmic Life Foundation is centered on empathy, direct grassroots impact, and timeless righteous duty.

items.title: Annadhanam (When Hunger ends, Dharma begins)
items.description: Distributing nutritious meals to the homeless and underprivileged families to ensure that no one in our community goes hungry.

items.title: Honoring the Unclaimed Souls with Dignified Cremation
items.description: We provide honorable final ceremonies for unclaimed bodies, ensuring every individual is treated with dignity, regardless of their circumstances.

items.title: Spreading the Dharmic Way of Life (Traditional life Education for the Public)
items.description: Inspiring lives rooted in Dharma by preserving sacred traditions and nurturing compassion, righteousness, and unity.

items.title: Educational Support (Investing in Education and Transforming lives)
items.description: Empowering students in government schools and colleges by providing tuition fees, uniforms, and study materials to ensure a bright future.

items.title: Women Empowerment (Every Women Deserves Opportunity, Respect and Dignity)
items.description: Supporting women through vocational training and skill-building workshops to help them achieve financial independence and lead confident lives.

items.title: Compassion Begins with Caring for Homeless People
items.description: Reaching out to homeless individuals with seasonal clothing, warm blankets, hygiene kits, and nourishing food across streets.

items.title: Other Additional Activities
items.description: Extending emergency disaster relief, victim family support, and humanitarian seva across boundaries wherever need arises.

stats.sectionTitle: Only Possible because of Friends Like You
stats.sectionDescription: Dharmic Life Foundation believes that transformative social impact happens when compassionate hearts unite. Every meal served, every destitute soul cremated with Vedic respect, and every student sponsored is powered by dedicated patrons and community volunteers.
stats.volunteerCardSubtitle: Uniting across districts with unconditional empathy.

eventsSection.title: Dharmic Impact Across the Map
eventsSection.subtitle: Glimpses of our regular community seva drives, cremation rites, educational camps, and public gatherings.

items.title: Honoring the Unclaimed Souls
items.summary: Solemn traditional cremation rites performed for unclaimed departed individuals with prayers for eternal peace.

items.title: Annadhanam
items.summary: Nutritious meal distribution and prasadam served to over 1,200 homeless and underprivileged individuals.

items.title: Bridging the Digital Divide: Empowering Students Through Technology
items.summary: Distribution of digital learning kits, tablets, and educational software to underprivileged students.

items.title: Empowering Motherhood and Honoring Womanhood
items.summary: Maternal nutrition drive, prenatal wellness kits distribution, and vocational training workshop for mothers.

items.title: Dressing with Dignity: Providing Warmth to the Homeless
items.summary: Distribution of new clothing, warm blankets, and hygiene kits to street dwellers and destitute families.

gallerySection.title: Our Seva in Pictures
gallerySection.subtitle: Witness our on-ground compassion across streets, government schools, communities, and crematoriums.

siteInfo.footerAboutText: Dharmic Life Foundation is a charitable Trust dedicated to feeding the hungry, supporting homeless communities, and spreading kindness through social service.
